resources.string: During a workout:|Tap the screen: pause or resume.|Back: pause.|Back while paused: the End workout? menu.|Resume: keep going.|Save: keep it and rate it.|Discard: delete it. Nothing is logged.|After the cool-down it ends and asks How did it feel?|Swipe up or down to change the rating. Tap to pick it. Back stays on this screen.
Tap the screen to open the link on your phone.
